summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Los Alamitos transient occupancy (hotel) tax from 8% to 12%.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the transient occupancy tax from 8 percent to 12 percent.
tax.quote: The City Council voted June 15 to ask voters to raise the transient occupancy tax from 8 percent to 12 percent

tax.text: A No vote does not raise the transient occupancy tax from 8 percent to 12 percent.
